about: The Fold-Off: an experimental 9:16 stickman parody of a big-money YouTube challenge show, made to test the format grammar from the AI 'MrBeast AGI challenge' clip DramaAlert shared (Nov 2026): familiar show format x a topical subject (AI), absurd stakes vs a tiny task, three contestants whose jokes are their stereotype, a runner gag that pays off as the last line, hard cuts on every line with shot/reverse-shot coverage and name slams. All characters are original; no real people, brands or companies. Kokoro voices, one per character. No music.

lines.text: All they have to do is fold one shirt.
